root_cause.technical: Typo in prod ConfigMap checkout-config: CHECKOUT_DB_POOL_MAX=5O (letter O) caused strconv.Atoi parse failure; hot-reload watcher exits fatally on invalid config, so every pod crashed then CrashLoopBackOff'd on restart.
root_cause.organizational: PR #1893 merged with branch-protection bypass (0/1 approvals) and Jira PLAT-4821 closed via admin override (skipped Code Review + QA) under sale-freeze time pressure.
latent_factors: config-schema-validate CI job skipped due to path-filter bug (PLAT-4802)
schema validation for numeric config never prioritised (PLAT-4815)
KubePodCrashLooping alert delayed 15 min and routed to low-urgency channel
